run_download_warc_cli: run the CLI script to download WARC files from Common Crawl using a job index
run_get_args_parser: run the argument parser to configure job index, metadata path, and number of processes
run_warc_downloader_map: run the WarcDownloader on a dataset using map with multiprocessing to download WARC files
run_save_warc_dataset: run save_to_disk to persist the downloaded WARC dataset and sync it to S3
run_compute_success_rate: run the success rate computation by counting non-empty warc_error entries in the dataset
